在这个AI无孔不入的时代，经常有人抱怨看到的文章“AI味”太浓，意思是这个文章可: In this era where AI is ubiquitous, people often complain that articles they read have too much "AI flavor," meaning the article may have been enhanced by AI and has become somewhat formulaic
但我们也许没意识到，这“AI味”有时就是“人味”，甚至是更浓、更高级的“人味”: But we may not have realized that this "AI flavor" is sometimes "human flavor," even a more concentrated and sophisticated "human flavor"
因为AI所生成的文章也好，设计的方案、对问题的回答也好，都是以人类已有的创作为基: Because AI-generated articles, as well as designed solutions and answers to questions, are all "generated" based on human creativity that has already existed
只不过这种让人感到陌生的“AI人味”，被我们有意无意地与一般意义上的“人味”区分: It's just that this unfamiliar "AI human flavor" has been intentionally or unintentionally distinguished from the general sense of "human flavor" by us
我们总以为AI应该有着异于“人的智能”的特质，所以天生就该“与众不同”: We have always assumed that AI should possess qualities that differ from "human intelligence," so it should inherently be "different from the ordinary"
但AI所做的工作，本质上只是把前人所做的工作重新处理一下，再送回到我们面前罢了，: But what AI does is essentially just reprocessing the work done by predecessors and sending it back to us, or put simply, it is just replacing "human labor" with "computing power"
AI给出的文本总让人似曾相识，因为那些“新文本”的“新”，更多表现在其文本的形式: The texts AI produces always seem familiar because the "newness" of these "new texts" is more expressed in the form of the texts, namely the "newness" of combination patterns, rather than the "newness" of textual materials
但文本形式的“新”，见多了也会失去新鲜感，这和人们见多了龙与格里芬也会“见怪不怪: But the "newness" of text form, after seeing more of it, will lose its freshness, just like people also become "unsurprised" after seeing many dragons and griffins, which inevitably produces what people call the "AI flavor"
不过，话说回来，生活中有时人比AI还要“AI味”: However, speaking of which, sometimes people in life are even more "AI-flavored" than AI itself
比如最近几年常出现在景点或者某个地方的“我在×××很想你”或者“想你的风还是吹到: For instance, in recent years, sign boards reading "I miss you so much at ×××" or "the wind that misses you has finally reached ×××" often appear at scenic spots or certain locations, and when mourning the deceased, people often say things like "heaven is missing ×××" or "God wanted ××× to come" and the like, which actually carry a very strong AI flavor. Yet people rarely associate these expressions with AI, often just dismissing them as "clichés"
之所以如此，是因为我们对人自身“AI味”的一面思之甚少，进而不知不觉夸大了AI与: The reason for this is that we have given little thought to the "AI-like" aspects of human nature itself, and thus unknowingly exaggerated the differences between AI and humans
现在被不少人“神化”的AI也是如此，好像AI可以脱离“人”而存在，其实AI的各种: The AI that is now being "mythologized" by many people is the same way; it seems as if AI can exist independent of "humans," but in fact, AI's various functions are equally "all too human," and the causal relationships, logical structures, and linguistic expressions it provides all stem from human design
甚至，因为AI是对各种人味的“提纯”和“浓缩”，就像糖精或者香精有着比原物更强烈: Moreover, because AI is a "purification" and "concentration" of various human flavors, just as saccharin or artificial flavoring has a more intense "taste" than the original substance, in a certain sense, it is more "human-like" than humans themselves
实际上，许多人写的文章、做出的回答也和AI没什么区别: In fact, many articles written by people and answers given by them are no different from what AI produces
比如考试的时候，学生的答题就大同小异，有时看起来也和AI无异: For example, during exams, students' answers are largely similar, and sometimes they look no different from AI responses
我看着看着就产生了一种AI感，转念一想才意识到这也算是一种“人味”，原因就是我在: As I read through them, I developed a sense of "AI-ness," but upon reflection, I realized this too counts as "human nature." The reason is that I had once lectured in class about the different criticisms of *A Dream of the Red Chamber* by Wang Guowei, Cai Yuanpei, Hu Shi, Lu Xun, and Li Chendong, and students simply wrote my explanations as standard answers on their exam papers
而我也因此有幸又“当”了一次AI: And thus I had the fortune of "becoming" an AI once again
说“又”是因为老师这个工作从某种意义上来说主要就是“教书”，就是输出知识和答疑解: I say "once again" because the profession of teaching, in a sense, is primarily about "education," that is, the output of knowledge and answering questions and resolving difficulties, which is very similar to AI. In fact, a truly "omniscient" AI would do better than us "human-flesh AIs"
当然，就像人会出现幻觉一样，AI也会出现“幻觉”，但平心静气地想想，人的幻觉可是: Of course, just as humans experience hallucinations, AI also experiences "hallucinations," but if we think about it calmly and fairly, human hallucinations are certainly no fewer in number
在此，我也很想说句不是那么正确的心里话：有时学生们写的文章水平参差不齐，读起来味: Here, I also very much want to say something that isn't quite correct from the heart: sometimes the articles written by students are of uneven quality, and reading them is tedious and insipid, far inferior to AI's writing, which is clear in viewpoint, coherent in expression, and uplifting to the mind
因此，或许我们应该对“AI味”有些新的认知: Therefore, perhaps we should develop a new understanding of "AI flavor"
